verdict.rationale: Supabase's own docs describe generating a `database.types.ts` file for your project, using database introspection to produce type-safe API definitions from the schema. The MCP server also exposes a `generate_typescript_types` tool, so the capability is first-party and reachable from more than one surface. missing for 10: no independent or hands-on corroboration, no detail on the exact CLI command or on keeping types in sync automatically when the schema changes, and no evidence of typed output for languages other than TypeScript.
